The two Puducherry Factories (Amendment) Rules PDFs (2019 and 2020) had to be fetched with the filename's embedded spaces percent-encoded (%20) — curl rejects a literal space in the URL ('Malformed input to a URL function'); the space-containing form is the one that appears in search results/links.

The dic.py.gov.in file is a legacy binary .doc (not .docx); pandoc cannot parse it, so verification used `file` to confirm it's a genuine MS Word binary (CDFV2) plus `strings -e l` (UTF-16LE extraction, the internal text encoding of legacy .doc files) to recover and read the real document text confirming its content and relevance.
